meta.title: Urbi — Case Study
meta.description: How Urbi is bridging the gap between municipalities and citizens through smart civic technology.

hero.title: Urbi
hero.subtitle: Bridging the gap between municipalities and citizens through smart, inclusive civic technology.

problem.label: The Challenge
problem.title: A Gap Between Citizens and Their Municipalities
problem.intro: Modern cities run on communication — yet in most municipalities, that communication is broken. Citizens feel disconnected from local decision-making, and local governments lack the tools to engage meaningfully with the communities they serve.
problem.card1Desc: Reporting issues, participating in local decisions, or simply getting updates from the municipality is slow, opaque, and often futile.
problem.card2Desc: Local governments have no reliable way to collect structured feedback, track recurring issues, or gather meaningful statistics from residents.
problem.card3Desc: Many juntas de freguesia still rely on manual processes for stock management, work orders, and occurrence tracking — creating inefficiency and data silos.

solution.label: The Solution
solution.title: A Unified Civic Platform
solution.body: Urbi is a two-sided platform designed to close the communication gap between citizens and local government. It gives citizens a voice and gives municipalities the tools, data, and intelligence they need to act on it.

citizens.title: For Citizens
items: Report issues and track their resolution in real time
Participate in local decisions and public consultations
Receive updates and notifications from the municipality
Access local services and information in one place

municipalities.title: For Municipalities
items: Centralised occurrence management dashboard
Statistical insights on resident reports and trends
AI-powered tools to prioritise and route issues
Communication and coordination tools across juntas

juntas.title: For Juntas de Freguesia
items: Stock and inventory management
Digital work orders (folhas de obra)
Inter-junta communication and coordination
Structured data collection and reporting

dotnet.name: .NET
dotnet.reason: Industrial strength. We chose .NET for its performance, reliability, and proven track record in enterprise environments. It gives Urbi the solid, scalable foundation its data infrastructure demands.

react.name: React
react.reason: Built for excellence. The municipality-facing web dashboard is built with React and Tailwind CSS, allowing us to craft a beautiful, responsive interface without compromising on speed or maintainability.

reactNative.name: React Native
reactNative.reason: One codebase, two platforms. The citizen-facing mobile app is built with React Native, delivering a native experience on both iOS and Android from a single, maintainable codebase.

tailwind.name: Tailwind CSS
tailwind.reason: Consistency at speed. Tailwind enables us to implement our design system coherently across the web application, keeping the UI sharp and maintainable as the product grows.

origin.label: Our Story
origin.title: From Academic Idea to Real Product
origin.p1: Urbi was born in an academic context — a response to a civic problem that everyone around us experienced but nobody had solved well. What started as a project concept quickly proved to have real-world potential.
origin.p2: We evolved the idea beyond its academic roots, deepening the problem research, mapping out both the citizen and municipality user journeys, and developing a product vision that could genuinely work in practice.
origin.p3: In 2026, Urbi will compete at Poliempreende, one of Portugal's leading entrepreneurship competitions for polytechnic students — a milestone that reflects the seriousness and ambition behind the project.

ai.label: The Future
ai.title: AI at the Core
ai.body: We're designing Urbi with AI integration from the ground up — not as a feature bolt-on, but as a fundamental part of how the platform works.
ai.item1Desc: AI automatically categorises and routes citizen reports to the right department, reducing response times dramatically.
ai.item2Desc: Identifying patterns and facilitating communication between multiple juntas that face similar recurring issues.
ai.item3Desc: Helping municipalities anticipate needs, allocate resources proactively, and make data-driven decisions.

intro.title: Introduction
intro.body: Proxio Solutions ('we', 'us', or 'our') is committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard the information you provide when using our website and services, in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable Portuguese law.

controller.title: Data Controller
controller.body: The data controller responsible for your personal data is Proxio Solutions, based in Portugal. For any data-related enquiries, please contact us at: hello@proxiosolutions.com

dataCollected.title: What Data We Collect
dataCollected.body: We only collect personal data that you voluntarily provide when using our contact form. This may include:
items: Full name
Email address
Subject and message content you submit

usage.title: How We Use Your Data
usage.body: The personal data you provide is used exclusively to respond to your enquiry and to maintain correspondence with you. We do not use your data for marketing or profiling purposes without your explicit consent.

legal.title: Legal Basis for Processing
legal.body: We process your personal data on the following legal grounds under the GDPR: your consent (Article 6(1)(a)), given when you submit our contact form; and our legitimate interest in responding to business enquiries (Article 6(1)(f)).

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.body: We retain your personal data only for as long as necessary to fulfil the purpose for which it was collected, or as required by applicable law. Contact enquiry data is generally retained for up to 2 years, after which it is securely deleted.

thirdParties.title: Third Parties
thirdParties.body: We do not sell, rent, or transfer your personal data to third parties for their own use. We may use trusted third-party service providers (such as email or hosting services) who process data on our behalf and are bound by strict data processing agreements and confidentiality obligations.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.body: As a data subject under the GDPR, you have the following rights:
items: Right of access — obtain a copy of your personal data
Right to rectification — correct inaccurate or incomplete data
Right to erasure — request deletion of your data ('right to be forgotten')
Right to restriction — request that we limit the processing of your data
Right to object — object to the processing of your data
Right to lodge a complaint with the CNPD (Comissão Nacional de Proteção de Dados) at www.cnpd.pt

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: Our website uses only strictly necessary technical cookies, such as storing your language preference. We do not use tracking, analytics, or advertising cookies. No personal data is collected through cookies.

contact.title: Contact & Data Requests
contact.body: To exercise any of your rights, ask questions about this Privacy Policy, or submit a data request, please contact us at: hello@proxiosolutions.com. We will respond within 30 days.
